identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of BL-B01D1 in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase II Clinical Study to Evaluate the Efficacy and Safety of BL-B01D1 for Injection in Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is an open-label, multicenter, phase II study to evaluate the safety, efficacy, and pharmacokinetic characteristics of BL-B01D1 for Injection in patients with recurrent glioblastoma.

armGroups.label: BL-B01D1 for Injection
armGroups.description: Participants receive BL-B01D1 in the first cycle (3 weeks). Participants with clinical benefit could receive additional treatment for more cycles. The administration will be terminated because of disease progression or intolerable toxicity occurring or other reasons.

interventions.name: BL-B01D1 for Injection
interventions.description: Administration by intravenous infusion for a cycle of 3 weeks.

primaryOutcomes.description: ORR is defined as the percentage of participants, who has a CR (disappearance of all target lesions) or PR (at least a 30% decrease in the sum of diameters of target lesions). The percentage of participants who experiences a confirmed CR or PR is according to RECIST 1.1.

secondaryOutcomes.description: The PFS is defined as the time from the participant's first dose of BL-B01D1 to the first date of either disease progression or death, whichever occurs first.

The DCR is defined as the percentage of participants who has a CR, PR, or Stable Disease (SD: neither sufficient shrinkage to qualify for PR nor sufficient increase to qualify for progressive disease \[PD: at least a 20% increase in the sum of diameters of target lesions and an absolute increase of at least 5 mm. The appearance of one or more new lesions is also considered PD\]).
The DOR for a responder is defined as the time from the participant's initial objective response to the first date of either disease progression or death, whichever occurs first.

TEAE is defined as any unfavorable and unintended change in the structure, function, or chemistry of the body temporally emerging, or any worsening (i.e., any clinically significant adverse change in frequency and/or intensity) of a pre-existing condition during the treatment of BL-B01D1. The type, frequency and severity of TEAE will be evaluated during the treatment of BL-B01D1.
Maximum serum concentration (Cmax) of BL-B01D1 will be investigated.
Time to maximum serum concentration (Tmax) of BL-B01D1 will be investigated.
Ctrough is defined as the lowest serum concentration of BL-B01D1 prior to the next dose will be administered.
Frequency of anti-BL-B01D1 antibody (ADA) will be investigated.
